messages:
tara: quick sync — we need a small cross-team plan to ship KV/prefix reuse attribution metrics so console can show tenant-level reuse and routing can use it for quota decisions. who owns metric names + tags?
Alex M: we should keep names simple & stable. proposal: 
  kvcache.prefix_hits_total{tenant,workload,route,prefix_sha}
  kvcache.prefix_misses_total{tenant,workload,route}
  kvcache.evictions_total{tenant,workload,shard}
  kvcache.reuse_count_total{tenant,workload,route}
Jin (eng-runtime): +1 to those names. runtime can emit prefix_sha and workload. caveat: computing prefix_sha on hot path adds CPU — we can sample or compute in a hot path optimized C path.
Mike R: ingestion/telemetry side: Cortex will ingest these as counters. need cardinality guardrails — tenant + workload + route + prefix_sha might explode. suggest capping prefix_sha tag to top-k (hot prefixes) and emit prefix_bucket instead for others.
Sana: product needs reuse% (per-tenant) and reuse_by_workload breakdown; also percentile distribution (p50/p95 reuse per request). UX: a single tenant view + comparison vs peers.
Alex M: derived metrics we can compute at query time: 
  reuse_rate = sum(kvcache.prefix_hits_total) / sum(kvcache.prefix_hits_total + kvcache.prefix_misses_total)
  reuse_per_request = sum(kvcache.reuse_count_total) / sum(requests_total{tenant})
Jin (eng-runtime): runtime will emit requests_total, and reuse_count_total increment for every request that reused a KV prefix. we'll add a boolean label reused=true occasionally to help queries.
Mike R: sampling strategy proposal: full emit for tenant tiers A/B, 1% sample for long-tail tenants. also roll up prefix_sha -> heavy_prefix=true for top 1000 by global hits.
Alex M: console team: what's the query language? PromQL is ok for now. Dashboard widgets: tenant reuse gauge, workload sparkline, heatmap of top prefixes, eviction rate chart, routing-recommendation flag.
Sana: can we show routing hints in rollout UX? e.g., recommend route X for tenant Y when reuse_rate>0.6 and latency<50ms. also show confidence (sample size).
tara: routing engineering note — routing policy can use reuse_rate per tenant to prefer the reuse-optimized pool. need an API: /routing/score?tenant=... returns score. who owns that endpoint?
Alex M: platform will own a small scoring service (stateless), reads from TSDB, caches per-tenant score for 60s. Can implement rule engine: score = w1*reuse_rate + w2*(1-eviction_rate) - w3*cost_delta.
Jin (eng-runtime): runtime should emit eviction_rate as evictions_total / kvcache.entries_total. entries_total is an expensive gauge but we can approximate with capacity estimate.
Mike R: metric ingestion tags: please standardize tenant -> tenant_id, workload -> workload_name, route -> route_name. add source=runtime. ops-bot: compliance note: PII free — prefix_sha must be hashed (sha256) and truncated.
Sana: product asks for alerting knobs: alert if tenant reuse drops by >30% week-over-week or eviction_rate > 5% sustained 10m. Also want annotation on dashboard for rollouts.
Alex M: rollout UX: we can add a canary toggle that ties to the scoring service. plan: 1) metric names + sampling doc 2) runtime emits + onboard 10 tenants 3) console dashboard prototype 4) enable scoring service 5) small canary routing experiment.
Jin (eng-runtime): timeline: can add basic emits in 2 sprints if we keep sampling defaults. prefix hashing will be in native path but only sampled.
Mike R: telemetry work: will add ingestion transforms to drop low-cardinality prefix shas and mark heavy_prefix=true. also add a daily job to recompute heavy prefix top-k.
tara: action items — Alex create metric name PR + sampling config by EOD Tue. Jin add emit PR by end of sprint. Mike add ingest transform ticket. Sana mock dashboard in figma. I'll own rollout runbook.
Alex M: copying example PromQLs for dashboard panels: 
  reuse_rate(tenant) = sum by (tenant) (increase(kvcache.prefix_hits_total[1h])) / sum by (tenant) (increase(kvcache.prefix_hits_total[1h]) + increase(kvcache.prefix_misses_total[1h]))
  eviction_rate(tenant) = increase(kvcache.evictions_total[1h]) / avg_over_time(kvcache.entries_total[1h])
  top_prefixes = topk(20, sum by (prefix_sha, tenant) (increase(kvcache.prefix_hits_total[1h])))
Jin (eng-runtime): include correlation id in logs for missed vs hit paths to aid debugging: header X-KV-Correlation.
Sana: UX request — show sample size (requests_total) and whether metric is sampled. small red badge if sampling < 0.5%.
Mike R: note on storage cost: metrics with cardinality > 1M/day will blow cost. enforce tenant-level rollups pushed every 5m.
ops-bot: automated note — created telemetry ticket #TE-402 and routing-score service stub #PL-88.
tara: perfect. let's sync Thurs 11am to validate console mock + ingest plumbing. thanks all :thumbsup:
